name: Pre-act + SE + small-init alpha
tagline: Pre-activation BN-ReLU-Conv block with squeeze-and-excitation channel attention and a learnable scalar residual gate (alpha=0.1).
diff_from_baseline: Combines the pre_activation baseline (BN-ReLU-Conv with alpha=0.1 scalar gate) with a small SE block (1x1-conv reduction r=max(planes/4,4), ReLU, sigmoid) inserted on the residual branch before the alpha multiply; shortcut is unchanged.

name: Pre-act + per-channel scale + ReZero alpha
tagline: Pre-activation block with per-output-channel learnable gain and a ReZero scalar gate initialized at zero so each block starts as identity.
diff_from_baseline: Pre-activation backbone like the pre_activation baseline, but replaces alpha=0.1 with a ReZero-style alpha=0 scalar gate, multiplies the residual by a learnable per-channel vector gamma initialized to 1, and drops the post-add ReLU so the trunk is fully linear at init.

name: GELU + SE + AvgPool shortcut + StochDepth
tagline: Post-activation GELU block with SE attention, AvgPool-then-1x1 strided shortcut, depth-decay stochastic drop, and per-channel learnable alpha.
init_recovers: ResNet basic block with SE when drop_prob=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines several baselines: post-activation Conv-BN block with GELU instead of ReLU, AvgPool+1x1+BN downsample shortcut (anti-aliased), SE channel attention, depth-linear stochastic drop with a depth-aware ceiling (uses a class-level _block_counter like the stochastic_depth baseline), and a per-channel learnable alpha initialized to 0.1 (broadcasting over spatial dims).

name: Pre-act + dual-context tanh calibrator
tagline: Pre-activation block whose residual is rescaled by a tanh gate built from both shortcut and residual global context, plus alpha=0.15.

key_hyperparams.name: mix m
key_hyperparams.role: blend of residual vs shortcut context for the calibrator

init_recovers: Pre-activation block when calibrator gate g=1
diff_from_baseline: Pre-activation main branch from pre_activation baseline, but extends the scalar alpha gate with a dual-context calibrator: shortcut and residual are each global-average-pooled, blended with a learnable scalar mix m, passed through tanh and shifted to gate ~1, then multiplied per-channel onto the residual; ends with a post-add ReLU.

name: Pre-act + SE + spatial CBAM + alpha
tagline: Pre-activation block with serial SE channel attention and CBAM-style spatial attention, then learnable alpha=0.1.
init_recovers: Pre-activation block when both attentions act as identity
diff_from_baseline: Adds CBAM (SE channel + 2-stat spatial) attention on top of the pre_activation baseline: residual branch is multiplied first by sigmoid(SE) and then by sigmoid(Conv3x3 of channel-mean+channel-max) before the alpha=0.1 scalar gate; no post-add ReLU.
